history.summary: IDENTITY UNCERTAIN - PROVISIONAL ENTRY: no temple explicitly named 'Pench Mahadev Temple' is documented in web sources despite targeted English and Hindi searches ('Pench Mahadev' Barghat/Seoni). The most likely documented referent is the Mahadev Temple listed for Barghat Tahsil, Seoni district (map listing, 6:00 AM-6:00 PM hours), since Barghat town sits on the Pench River - a riverside Mahadev shrine there is the natural reading of the CSV name. Other Seoni-region Shiva shrines (Mahakaleshwar Mandir at Dighori, Ghogara Mahadev on the Pench in Nagpur district, Maharashtra) are distinct places and have not been conflated here. The founding date, patron and detailed history are unverified; needs ground-truthing before use. CSV note: 'Seoni' is the district - the temple belongs to the Barghat area of Seoni district, documented accordingly.

name: Pench Mahadev Temple
town_description: Barghat is a town and tehsil in Seoni district, Madhya Pradesh, on the banks of the Pench River, near the Pench Tiger Reserve landscape; the Mahadev Temple listing belongs to Barghat Tahsil.

travel.airport: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar International Airport, Nagpur (~130 km) is the nearest major airport.
travel.railway: Seoni railway station is the nearest railhead for the Barghat area.
travel.road: Barghat is connected by MP SH 26 and local roads; the temple listing is in Barghat Tahsil.

visitor_information.best_time: Maha Shivaratri and the Sawan month for special worship; October to March for pleasant weather.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Map listing shows 6:00 AM-6:00 PM daily (verify locally, as the identity itself is provisional).
